decisions.reason: The complete cases resolve the form as the personal name/title 廣燈禪師 or as a shortened bibliographic reference to 天聖廣燈錄; the corpus does not deploy 廣燈 as an independent Chan expression.
All complete cases are self-titles, headings, or citations of 嘉泰普燈錄. The title is contained in Chan books but is not itself deployed as a saying or technical expression.
Two corpus-attested things: the horse's foot and, in 露出馬腳, the giveaway that exposes a flaw.
Masters deploy the heel-following image as a verdict on derivative movement, language, and understanding.

Across the full cases 貨利 retains its ordinary sense of goods/material profit, usually in stock lists with 聲色 or 名利. Masters mention it, but do not give the compound an observable Chan-specific lexical job.
